alps.title: BEAR.ApiDoc Term Usage Index Profile

descriptor.title: Term Usage Index
descriptor.doc: The index document. Lists every identifier used in the generated API documentation and where it appears. A companion view to the main API documentation (index.html), one meta level above it.

descriptor.title: Indexed Term
descriptor.doc: An identifier used in the API: a request parameter name or a JSON Schema property name. The entry collects every place the identifier appears. Listing is by lexical spelling, so the same spelling used in unrelated places is collected under one entry.

descriptor.title: ALPS-backed Term
descriptor.doc: Marks a term whose spelling also exists as a descriptor id in the configured application ALPS profile (the `alps` setting in apidoc.xml). Shown with a checkmark. This is a lexical match only and does not prove that the indexed term and the application descriptor mean the same thing. The application descriptor id is exposed on the entry's `data-alps` attribute for cross-reference.

descriptor.title: Borrowed Descriptor Detail
descriptor.doc: Descriptor metadata (title, def, doc) shown on an ALPS-backed entry. The value is borrowed from the configured application ALPS profile for display; this index is not its authority. A `def` that is a URL links to the external vocabulary it references.

descriptor.title: Usage Occurrence
descriptor.doc: One place where the term appears in the API documentation.

descriptor.title: Parameter Usage
descriptor.doc: The term is used as a request parameter of an endpoint, written as "parameter: METHOD /path {term}". Extracted from the resource method signature.

descriptor.title: Schema Property Usage
descriptor.doc: The term is used as a JSON Schema property, written as "schema property: file.json#/json/pointer". Extracted from request and response schema files.

descriptor.title: Reserved Representation Field
descriptor.doc: A leading-underscore field such as `_links` or `_embedded`. Listed separately because it usually belongs to the representation format (HAL) rather than the API domain vocabulary.

descriptor.title: Terms Used Count
descriptor.doc: Number of distinct API terms collected (excluding reserved representation fields).

descriptor.title: ALPS-matched Count
descriptor.doc: Number of collected terms whose spelling matches a descriptor id in the configured application ALPS profile.

descriptor.title: Lexical ALPS Coverage
descriptor.doc: alpsMatchedCount divided by termsUsedCount, as a percentage. A lexical coverage figure, not a semantic one.

descriptor.title: Reserved Field Count
descriptor.doc: Number of distinct reserved representation fields collected.
